description.value: Hands reach out from the target’s shadow or dark areas in the target’s square, attempting to entangle the target, preventing it from moving farther than 5 feet from its original position. The target may attempt to break free from the grasps as a full-round action . Creatures with flying may only hover in place or fall to the ground while under this effect. This spell automatically fails if there is no surrounding shadows or darkness.
